ask: Draft the designer agent definition and its write-scope guard, and decide: does the designer run /design itself, or do you run it and hand the canvas to the builder?
note: Route with one test: does the lane touch a screen? Needs a standing exception to the Sonnet ceiling, like the third builder try (fits c17, Opus on your word). Canvas: Claude Code's /design drafts the mockup as artboards on a Claude Design canvas, published as an artifact; /design-sync pulls the repo's design system in first, and a finished design hands back to Claude Code to build (needs v2.1.234 or later; the standalone claude.ai/design site closes Dec 14, 2026, the Design artifact type stays). Review: you select an element on the published mockup, comment and Send to Claude; the builder reads the threads before building. Comments need your Enterprise account with the artifact shared in the organization; on Max, use a copy-as-prompt button.
title: Add a designer agent
why: Opus makes a mockup for every screen lane, so Sonnet builds to a picture of the target, and you comment on the exact element.
